jobs.prompt:
Release train 2, two security-review gaps in tools/scope-commands.mjs (Opus security review on this train).
B16: in cmdSync (around the `if (syncCheck.kind === 'delete-only') { await lockedTransition(root, t.id, 'done', ...); done.push(t.id); continue; }` branch), a delete-only ticket is marked done BEFORE the security review check that every other ticket goes through later in the same loop. securityReviewReason (tools/security-review.mjs) counts deletes, so a delete-only ticket touching auth/api/db paths skips the Opus security review. Fix: a delete-only ticket must pass the same security-review requirement as the normal path before it is marked done: find how the normal path in the same loop checks the security review (and how it records a ticket that is waiting on review, e.g. the unreviewed/needs-review list and --accept-unreviewed handling) and apply exactly that to the delete-only branch; only when no security review is required, or it passed, or the owner accepted unreviewed, transition to done. Keep the delete-only acceptance check as is.
B17: sensitiveDeliveredRefusals returns [] unless ticket.sensitive === true, so `swarm tickets <ID> --delivered <PR>` skips the security review for a ticket that touches sensitive paths but was never flagged. Fix: require the security review when ticket.sensitive === true OR securityReviewReason(ticket) is non-null (same rule as sync). Keep the refusal text and everything else.
Tests in NEW tests/train2-review-gaps.test.mjs (first import: import './_isolate-config.mjs';), driving runScopeCommand / runTicketsCommand in a temp project the way tests/tickets-delivered.test.mjs and tests/scope-sync-delete.test.mjs do: (1) a delete-only ticket whose deletes include src/auth/session.ts is NOT marked done by sync --integrated without a passing security review, and is marked done once the review passes (or with --accept-unreviewed and a reason, if that is how the normal path works); (2) a delete-only ticket deleting a non-sensitive file is still marked done as before; (3) --delivered on an unflagged ticket whose files include an auth path is refused without the security review and allowed with it; (4) --delivered on a non-sensitive unflagged ticket still works. Change nothing else.
jobs.ignoreTestsReason: tools/scope-commands.mjs is referenced by about 50 test files; this change is limited to the delete-only sync branch and sensitiveDeliveredRefusals, and the coordinator runs the scope, sync, delivered and acceptance suites as checks.
